facts.text: Andrew mentions that seeing birds up close is amazing due to their graceful and free flight.

evidence.quote: I've seen them up close and it's amazing how they fly with grace and freedom.
Yeah, birds are really amazing! I love how they can fly around and explore.

facts.text: Audrey expresses a desire for the freedom that birds have, comparing it to the experience of flying.

evidence.quote: They have a freedom that I wish I had!

facts.text: Andrew finds watching birds fly to be a freeing and awe-inspiring experience.

evidence.quote: Watching them fly is so freeing and awe-inspiring.
